jp: インセストが奪われた！
en: It's bad! The Incests have been taken!
What!?

jp: 何者かが見張りを襲い、
en: It seems someone attacked the guard and took the Incests from their cell.

jp: レッド・ムフロン様に
このことが伝わったら・・・
en: Damn it! How could this happen!! If word of this reaches Red Mouflon-sama...

jp: まだ遠くには行ってないはずだ！
en: They can't have gotten far! Move!!

jp: ひょっとしてヨハネ達が先に？
en: That conversation... Could Johannes and the others have beaten us to it?

jp: でも、あたし達以外の誰かが
手引きしたのかしら・・・
en: That's impossible. But did someone besides us help them out...?

jp: インセストが牢屋に居ないのなら
いったいどこを捜せば・・・
en: Oh dear. If the Incests aren't in the cells, where on earth should we search...

jp: 移動したインセスト達を
捜し出すしかないわね
en: We'll just have to find where the Incests were moved to, somehow.

jp: どこを捜せばいいんだよ
en: Oh, man. Easy to say "search," but where are we supposed to look?
Ooh, ooh, ooh!
Listen, it's this way! This way!
...Lilis?

jp: 二人ともこっちにいるの！
en: They're both over this way!

jp: 二人とは、まさか・・・
en: Both... you can't mean...

jp: リリスよく覚えているもん！
この感じはマティアお姉ちゃんと
en: Lilis remembers it really well! This feeling is Matia-neesan and Kilota!!
Kilota too!?

jp: 二人の居場所がわかるの？
en: You know where they are?

jp: マティアお姉ちゃんはいつでも
カインを呼んでいるよ
en: Can't you hear it? Matia-neesan is always calling for Cain.

jp: とても強い想いだから
リリスにもはっきり聞こえる
en: It's such a strong feeling that even Lilis can hear it clearly.
Matia is...

jp: わたし達にはわかりませんが
リリスには誰かを感じ取る
不思議な力があるんです
en: We don't understand it ourselves, but Lilis has a strange power to sense people.

jp: この子の力を信じてあげて下さい
en: Cain-san, please believe in this girl's power.

jp: でも、闇雲に動くのは危険よ
en: But moving blindly is dangerous.

jp: ボクはリリスの力を信じるよ
en: I believe in Lilis's power.

jp: リリスを信じてくれる？
en: ...Really? You believe Lilis?
But...

jp: 他の人には聞こえない声を
en: Matia could hear voices no one else could hear, too.

jp: 同じ力を持ってるんだ
en: I'm sure Lilis has the same power.
Can we really... trust in it?

jp: リリスの力を信じて下さい
en: It's all right. Please trust Lilis's power.
...Syria-neesan.

jp: 案内してちょうだい、リリス
en: Now, lead us to the two of them, Lilis.
Okay!

jp: 早くしないと、天使様が
二人を捕まえちゃうの！
en: This way, hurry! If we're not quick, the angel will catch them both!
The angel?

jp: たぶん、六翼の天使様なの！
en: This angry feeling... it's probably the six-winged angel!
Six wings!? ...It can't be.
Quick! Hurry!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
